item.title: Connected data keeps moving
item.summary: Murph now keeps delayed wearable imports moving alongside routine background work, helping connected activity and health data reach follow-up work without repeated delay.
item.details: Recovery stays bounded so retained imports can catch up without holding up other background work. Interrupted progress checkpoints now converge on the next pass instead of causing repeated retries, and Murph does not mark data processed until the import succeeds or reaches a confirmed failure.
